items.title: Dutch regulator fines Uber €824.99m over automated driver dismissals
items.summary: The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found that Uber relied on software to track driver conduct and customer feedback, leading to accounts being automatically suspended over suspected fraud and permanently shut down where ratings stayed low over time.

items.title: Why Tesla’s Nevada Robo-Taxi Approval Can’t Save the Stock
items.summary: The long-awaited scaling up of  Tesla’s  robo-taxi service might be close.  The Nevada Transportation Authority has approved autonomous vehicle applications for Tesla,  Alphabet’s  Waymo, and Aviari, an  Uber  platform.  Tesla will be allowed to deploy up to 5,000 robo-taxis over the coming 12 months.
